name: dc_fast
description: CHAdeMO on a healthy pack: 44 kW held to about 60 %, a hard taper above it, and the pack heating fast enough that the thermal derate starts biting near the end. ASSERTED, not measured — nobody has put this car on a fast charger with a logger. Shape only. When the session ends the car is off, so only the load table's base_off drain remains. Runs at REAL TIME (1x), like every shipped scenario bar degradation_arc: compress it yourself with --speed, or with the cockpit's Time card, so the clock is always one you chose (docs/SIMULATOR.md, 'Compressing time'). The session is about 45 minutes at 1x; `--speed 60` puts it into 45 seconds.
